727-506
Leverett Saltonstall Building, Room 909 100 Cambridge Street, Boston 02202
June 7, 1972
Yates M. Barber, Jr., Acting Chief
Office of Environmental Quality
Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
U.S. Department of the Interior
Washington, D.C. 20240
RE:
DRAFT ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACE STATEMENT - H.R.1311 STATE CLEARINGHOUSE IDENTIFIER-72040176
Dear Mr. Barber:
The Massachusetts State Clearinghouse has received a copy of the draft Environmental Impact Statement for the proposed Endangered Spacies Conservation Act of 1972 (H.R.1311). The statement was made available to applicable state environmental offices and agencies for review and comment in accordance with the provisions of Section 102 (2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969.
We have been advised by the Massachusetts Division of Fisheries and Game that after a thorough review of H.R.1311 the Division has no objections to the draft Environmental Impact Statement for the proposed legislation.
Sincerely,
Robert W
NCTE
Please be advised that the Office of Planning and Program
Coordination (OPPC) was disestablished February 14, 1972. OPPC
and the Office of Program Management were consolidated into one
office, the Office of State Planning and Management. Accordingly,
correspondence relative to OPPC and the Office of Project
Management should be addressed to the Office of State Planning
In order to make use of existing paper stock, the Office of State Planning and Management will continue to use CPPC labeled
